rows.en: Intercept E2 Launch
Escort friendly warship
Friendly warship sunk
Destroy the recon helicopter
Intelligence has learned the Poseidal Army contacted the <cs(1)>Unified Empire of Giganos<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: We can be almost certain that an E2 has fallen into Giganos hands as well.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: The Giganos <pt(0,-80,0,1)><mk(-37.5,-75,4,1,50)><mk(0,-50,4,1,100)><mk(37.5,-75,4,1,150)>forces have stopped moving near the <pic(0)><cs(3)>launch base<ce()> that they occupy.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Most likely, they are preparing to transfer the E2 into space.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Giganos, a Moon-based anti-Earth power, clearly intends to use the E2 militarily.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: We must stop them, whatever it takes.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Right now, <mk(12.5,30,0,3)><ar(0,0,3)>the <pic(1)><cs(3)>Nadesico B<ce()> is heading for the launch base ahead of us.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Now <mk(-12.5,50,0,0)><ar(0,0,0)>we'll join up with the Nadesico B and help secure the <pic(2)><cs(3)>area around the base<ce()>.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Military satellites have confirmed a Giganos transport shuttle has left the atmosphere.
rows.speaker: UCE superior?

rows.en: At almost the same time, a Poseidal Army spaceship was also confirmed to have launched.
rows.speaker: UCE superior?

rows.en: This means the E2s have spread into space. The situation is now even more serious.
rows.speaker: UCE superior?

rows.en: In light of this, you will also go up into space and continue the pursuit mission.
rows.speaker: UCE superior?

rows.en: I want the Nadesico B to head toward Amaterasu to track the Poseidal Army,
rows.speaker: UCE superior?

rows.en: and the Ra Cailum to head for the Moon to keep the E2 out of the Giganos Lunar Empire.
rows.speaker: UCE superior?

rows.en: To make up for your failures so far, I demand even greater effort from all of you.
rows.speaker: UCE superior?

rows.en: Just what do you think you are doing? Is that all the strength you have?
rows.speaker: UCE superior?

rows.en: You carry the future of Earth. This will not do. Pull yourselves together.
rows.speaker: UCE superior?
